                                    ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITV OF CHICAGO;


SECTION 1. Title 17 of Ihe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the RT-3.5 Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District, as shown on Map 9-G in the area bounded by:

A line 187 feet North of and parallel to West Belmont Avenue; the alley next east of
and parallel to North Southport Avenue; a line 162 feet North of and parallel to
West Belmont Avenue; and North Southport Avenue.

To those of RIVI-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
duepubhcation.




Common Address of Property: 3217 North Southport Ave., Chicago, IL
                                   NARRATIVE AND PLANS
                                 FOR THE PROPOSED REZONING
                                             AT
                                3217 NORTH SOUTHPORT AVENUE
The Application is to change zoning for 3217 North Southport Avenue from RT-3.5 Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District. The Applicant intends to
construct a three (3) dwelling unil building with a basement and partial fourth floor, 'fhere vvill be three
garage parking spaces. The footprint ofthe building shall approximately be 19 feet 8 inches by 71 feet 10
inches in size. The building height shall be 45 feet high, as defined by Cily code.

SPACES PROVIDED.
